running_thesis: Nvidia leads the AI trade swings. On 25 Nov the Nasdaq-100 touched bear territory intraday and closed at 26046.9 (-0.64%) as dip buyers stepped in. S&P put Nvidia debt on CreditWatch negative and Moody's cut the outlook. Core PCE 3.26% y/y per FRED. The 10-year yield is 4.85%. VXN 38.53, VIX 28.29, COR1M 25.45. A December hike is priced (Polymarket 94.5%), January odds 59% per CME per Cboe. US was closed on 26 Nov and 27 Nov is a thin half-day. Premarket headlines (unverified) show futures rising. Jobs data on 1 and 4 Dec lead into the 9 Dec FOMC.
open_questions: Do dip buyers hold in Friday's thin session and on Monday?
Do Nvidia credit and governance issues escalate before the early-December hearings?
Is the tariff concern confirmed with detail?
Do JOLTS and jobs data (1 and 4 Dec) move the 9 Dec hike path?
